newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY PARLIAMENT LIFTS PARTY TREASURER IMMUNITY.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY PARLIAMENT LIFTS PARTY TREASURER IMMUNITY.

text.p: Hungary's parliament on Tuesday lifted the legal immunity of Laszlo Boldvai, an MP allegedly affected by a scandal over irregular payments to a privatisation negotiator, the Hungarian Television said.
Boldvai is the treasurer of the Socialist Party (MSZP), which is the senior member of Hungary's ruling coalition.

The parliament decision opens the way for the Public Prosecutor to initiate criminal proceedings against Boldvai, suspected with trafficking with influence, a crime which can be punished with prison of up to one year in Hungary, the television said.
Boldvai is alleged to have been in connection with Marta Tocsik, a negotiator of the state privatisation APV who received irregular payments of millions of dollars from APV last year.

According to earlier press reports, part of the money may have been transferred to companies and foundations under the influence of supporters of MSZP and the junior coalition member Free Democrats (SZDSZ).
MSZP, SZDSZ and Boldvai denied that they had been affected by the scandal. Boldvai also asked the parliament to lift his immunity.
